title: Always On Top needs a restart after settings changed

judgment.rationale: There is already a public fork-side fix path for this Always On Top bug, so the dashboard should point maintainers at the existing work instead of re-triaging the same settings hot-reload problem as a new design-stage item.
evidence: The upstream issue is unchanged since the original report that Always On Top setting changes only apply after restarting the module.

Current source in src/modules/alwaysontop/AlwaysOnTopModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp still shows AlwaysOnTopModuleInterface::set_config parsing and saving settings without directly notifying the running process.
Current source in src/modules/alwaysontop/AlwaysOnTop/Settings.cpp still has the live reload watcher path that posts WM_PRIV_SETTINGS_CHANGED when the settings file changes.
A public fork mirror issue, prior fork PR, and surviving public branch already exist for this fix path, so creating a fresh actionable design from the dashboard would duplicate existing work.
judgment.recommended_action: Treat the issue as already handled by existing public fix work and keep it out of the design-stage queue until maintainers explicitly choose to revive that branch or request a fresh design.

fix_assessment.rationale: A concrete public fork-side implementation path already covers the reported settings hot-reload gap.

issue_context.summary: This issue reports that Always On Top setting changes do not take effect until the module is restarted, and existing public fork artifacts already capture the reviewed hot-reload fix path.
known_information: The original report is against PowerToys 0.100.2 and gives a clear repro: change Always On Top settings, observe no effect, then disable and re-enable the module and see the settings applied.
The upstream issue has no later comments or new evidence after the original report.
AlwaysOnTopModuleInterface::set_config in src/modules/alwaysontop/AlwaysOnTopModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp still persists settings by calling save_to_settings_file().

AlwaysOnTopSettings::InitFileWatcher in src/modules/alwaysontop/AlwaysOnTop/Settings.cpp still posts WM_PRIV_SETTINGS_CHANGED when the settings file changes, which is the existing live-reload path the fork fix was built around.
A public fork mirror issue, prior fork PR, and the branch copilot/fix-aot-settings-reload already exist for Issue 49599.
inferences: The technical diagnosis is still the same hot-reload gap that the prior fork work already investigated.
Because a concrete public implementation path already exists, the dashboard should not continue presenting this issue as a new design-stage item.
issue_context.analysis: The artifact was rejected because stage awaiting_pr_approval is treated as a design-stage state by the validator. That stage was inappropriate for a duplicate_or_handled issue whose evidence says existing public fix work already covers it. The corrected artifact keeps the existing-fix evidence, removes the improper actionable PR-opening control, and returns the issue to a non-design triage stage so publish validation no longer expects a design payload.
initial_investigation: src/modules/alwaysontop/AlwaysOnTopModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp still saves settings in AlwaysOnTopModuleInterface::set_config without directly notifying the running process.

src/modules/alwaysontop/AlwaysOnTop/Settings.cpp still contains AlwaysOnTopSettings::InitFileWatcher and AlwaysOnTopSettings::LoadSettings, confirming the previously identified live reload path remains relevant.
The prior fork PR is closed, but the public branch and mirror issue remain the current reusable fix trace and make a second dashboard-started design unnecessary.
